long_biography.plain_text:
Property developer Jean-Baptiste Pastor took responsibility for MoNa Résidence, a project initiated by his father, Michel. Working with architects and specialist contractors, the group combined luxury apartments with an energy system based on deep geothermal exchange. Residents can adjust temperatures room by room and monitor their consumption, making energy management part of everyday occupation.

As vice-president of AMPA, Monaco’s Alzheimer’s research association, Pastor works alongside its president, his mother Catherine. The association supports scientific meetings, informs the public and helps carers, including practical projects to improve facilities for people living with the disease.
